Pinned API evidence addendum (2026-09-03)

The exact v8.1.3 public and positional preconditions are:
- `hcl2.api.parses_to_tree(text: str) -> Tree` (distinct from `parse_to_tree(file: TextIO)`) and it is exported by `hcl2.__init__`.
- `hcl2.parser.parser()` constructs Lark with `propagate_positions=True`.
- An isolated exact-wheel invocation of `parses_to_tree` observed `Tree.meta` coordinates block `1:1–3:2`, attribute `2:2–2:15`.

Sources:
https://github.com/amplify-education/python-hcl2/blob/v8.1.3/hcl2/api.py
https://github.com/amplify-education/python-hcl2/blob/v8.1.3/hcl2/__init__.py
https://github.com/amplify-education/python-hcl2/blob/v8.1.3/hcl2/parser.py
